summary: Iteration 10 frontend-only validation of the Quantro landing narrative redesign (Apple-keynote-style). Verified section order, presence of 4 new sections (ProblemSystem, InteractiveDemo, Cinematic, Amanecer), updated ValueStack copy + $399→$59 comparison, removal of 5 old sections, ES/EN i18n, interactive pill behavior, and light backend regression.

minor.issue: GET returns 404. This endpoint was hit as a speculative regression check; actual insights path may differ, so this is informational only — not tested as part of the current review spec.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=chat-widget-trigger] did not reveal [data-testid=chat-widget-panel] within 1s during automated test. Likely framer-motion AnimatePresence delay rather than a real bug — manual verification recommended. Backend /api/chat/message responds 200.

issues: LanguageSwitcher ES/EN buttons have no data-testid (only text). Adding data-testid='lang-toggle-es' / 'lang-toggle-en' would make future tests more robust.

action_items: OPTIONAL CLEANUP: Remove now-unused file /app/frontend/src/components/QuantroMorningDemo.jsx (it is no longer imported but still present in the repo).

OPTIONAL CLEANUP: Navbar.jsx (line 69, 127) and HeroSection.jsx (line 120) still call scrollToSection('morning-snapshot'). That anchor no longer exists in the DOM, so these clicks silently do nothing. Point them at 'interactive-demo' or 'amanecer' instead (or rewire to the new narrative).
OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENT: Add data-testid to LanguageSwitcher ES/EN buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: TOOLS array in ValueStackSection.jsx sums to 399 exactly (99+119+59+25+39+29+29) — matches spec.
All new section components (ProblemSystemSection, InteractiveDemoSection, CinematicTransitionSection, AmanecerSection) ship ES/EN copy via the i18n hook and render correctly when language is toggled.
InteractiveDemoSection preview content is static inline mock data per product spec — not a bug, explicitly intended.
QuantroMorningDemo.jsx still lives in /components/ but is orphaned (no import). Dead code — safe to delete.

success_rate.backend: 100% (of the 2 endpoints relevant to this review that were hit)
